examples.ko: 이 앱은 한국의 작은 회사에서 개발됐어요.
examples.en: This app was developed by a small company in Korea.
A new vaccine is being developed quickly.

examples.ko: 이 지역은 앞으로 크게 개발될 거예요.
examples.en: This area will be developed on a large scale.

examples.ko: 개발된 지 얼마 안 된 기술이에요.
examples.en: It's a technology that was developed not long ago.
When new technology is developed, life gets easier.
A new drug was developed, and the patients are happy.

explain: 기술·제품·약처럼 새로 만들어질 때도, 땅이 새 도시나 단지가 될 때도 '개발되다'를 써요. 사람이 주어이면 '개발하다'예요. 이미 있는 것이 더 좋아질 때는 '발전하다'나 '발달하다'가 더 자연스러워요.
explain_en: Use '개발되다' both when a technology, product or drug is newly created and when land is turned into a new town or complex. With a person as the subject, it becomes '개발하다'. For something that already exists and improves, '발전하다' or '발달하다' fits better.

dis.h: made ready for use, like products or land

p.n: 계발되다 is limited to abilities or the mind; 개발되다 is broader.

examples.en: I tutor a middle school student every weekend.
Last year I tutored my younger sibling in math.

examples.ko: 방학 동안 이웃집 아이에게 영어를 과외할 거예요.
examples.en: I will tutor a neighbor's child in English during vacation.
The tutor came to our house.
I tutor as a part-time job and earn pocket money.

examples.ko: 제가 과외해 준 학생의 성적이 올랐어요.
examples.en: The grades of the student I tutored went up.

explain: 선생님은 '과외를 하다', 학생은 '과외를 받다'라고 말하는 경우가 많아요. 여러 학생이 함께 듣는 '학원'과는 달리 한 명이나 적은 인원이 가르침을 받아요.
explain_en: The teacher usually says '과외를 하다' and the student says '과외를 받다'. Unlike a '학원' (cram school) with many students, private lessons are for one person or a small group.

examples.en: I arrived at the test site an hour early.
The test site is a school gym.
Turn off your phone inside the test site.

examples.ko: 시험장이 너무 추워서 겉옷을 챙겨 갔어요.
examples.en: The test site was so cold that I brought a jacket.
I wandered around for a long time looking for the test site.

examples.ko: 시험장에서 만난 친구와 같이 점심을 먹었어요.
examples.en: I had lunch with a friend I met at the test site.

explain: 수능 같은 큰 시험에서는 미리 정해진 학교가 시험장이 돼요. 학교 안의 평소 시험은 보통 '교실'에서 봐요. '시험장에 들어가다', '시험장에서 나오다'처럼 써요.
explain_en: In big exams like the CSAT, a school decided in advance becomes the '시험장'. Ordinary tests at school are normally taken in the classroom. Say '시험장에 들어가다' (enter) or '시험장에서 나오다' (leave).

examples.en: My younger sibling attends an art academy.
I'm learning to cook at an academy.

examples.ko: 그 영화는 아카데미 시상식에서 상을 받았어요.
examples.en: That film won an award at the Academy Awards.
A new academy opened in our neighborhood.
Academy classes start in the evening.
My friend works as an instructor at an English academy.

explain: 한국에서는 학원 이름에 '아카데미'를 붙이는 곳이 있어요. 영화의 '아카데미상'에도 같은 말이 들어가요. 일반적인 학원을 부를 때는 '학원'이라고 해요.
explain_en: Some private institutes in Korea put 아카데미 in their names. The same word is part of the film award 아카데미상. For a typical cram school or institute, the usual word is 학원.

examples.ko: 영화사에서 새 영화의 배우를 찾고 있어요.
examples.en: The film company is looking for actors for its new movie.
After graduating from university, I got a job at a film company.

examples.ko: 그 영화사는 작은 영화를 많이 만들어요.
examples.en: That film company makes many small movies.
The film company will release the trailer next month.

examples.ko: 영화사 직원이 감독님과 회의를 하고 있어요.
examples.en: A film company employee is having a meeting with the director.

examples.ko: 큰 영화사와 계약한 감독이 새 영화를 준비해요.
examples.en: The director who signed with a big film company is preparing a new movie.

explain: '출판사', '방송사', '여행사'처럼 '-사'로 끝나는 회사 이름 중 하나예요. 영화를 직접 만드는 회사도, 극장에 영화를 공급하는 회사도 영화사라고 불러요.
explain_en: It is one of the company names ending in -사, like 출판사, 방송사, and 여행사. Both studios that make films and firms that supply films to theaters are called 영화사.

examples.ko: 오늘 선생님이 안 계셔서 자습을 했어요.
examples.en: The teacher wasn't here today, so we had self-study.

examples.ko: 야간 자습이 끝나고 집에 가면 열 시예요.
examples.en: When I get home after evening self-study, it's ten o'clock.
You have to be quiet during self-study time.
Studying alone is hard, so I go to a cram school.

examples.ko: 수업이 갑자기 자습으로 바뀌어서 다들 좋아했어요.
examples.en: The class suddenly turned into self-study, and everyone was happy.
During vacation I study by myself at the library.

explain: 학교에서 선생님이 가르치지 않고 학생이 스스로 공부하는 시간을 '자습 시간'이라고 해요. '자습을 시키다'는 선생님 입장, '자습하다'는 학생 입장에서 써요. 선생님 없이 혼자 배우는 것은 '독학'이라고도 해요.
explain_en: At school, a period where students study on their own without a teacher teaching is called '자습 시간'. '자습을 시키다' is from the teacher's side and '자습하다' from the student's. Learning alone without a teacher can also be called '독학'.

examples.en: I work at home at night.
I went to bed late working on a video yesterday.
I'm in the middle of working on the design.
The friend I worked with helped me.

examples.ko: 조용한 카페에서 작업하면 집중이 잘 돼요.
examples.en: I focus well when working in a quiet cafe.
I'll work on this drawing until tomorrow.

explain: 공부나 사무가 아니라 그림, 영상, 음악, 사진처럼 만드는 결과물이 있는 일에 잘 써요. 회사 일 전반은 '일하다'가 자연스러워요. '작업'은 '작업 중'처럼 명사로도 많이 써요.
explain_en: It fits work that yields something you make, like pictures, videos, music or photos, not studying or office tasks. For jobs in general, the plain verb for 'work' sounds more natural. The noun form is also used often, as in 'in progress'.

dis.h: work on a task, project or craft

p.n: 작업하다 means working on a specific piece of work. 일하다 is more general and often means having a job.

examples.en: A debate will be held at school tomorrow.
The debate lasted for two hours.
I am preparing for the debate with a friend.
The teacher also took part in this debate.
Many opinions came up at the debate.

examples.ko: 집에서도 토론회 방송을 볼 수 있어요.
examples.en: You can watch the debate broadcast from home as well.

explain: '토론'은 말로 의견을 주고받는 일이고, '토론회'는 그런 자리를 여는 행사예요. 선거 때 뉴스에서 '후보 토론회'라는 말이 자주 나와요.
explain_en: '토론' is the exchange of opinions in speech, and '토론회' is the event held for it. In election news you often hear '후보 토론회' (candidate debate).

examples.en: The teacher handed out printouts.
One printout is missing.
This handout will be on tomorrow's test.
Write your name on the printout and hand it in.
I find it easier to study with printouts.
I put the class handouts in my bag too.

explain: 종이에 인쇄한 수업 자료를 가리킬 때 써요. 옷에 그려진 무늬도 '프린트 티셔츠'처럼 같은 말을 써요. 인쇄하는 일은 '인쇄'나 '프린트하다'라고 해요.
explain_en: It refers to course material printed on paper. A pattern on clothes uses the same word, as in 프린트 티셔츠. The act of printing is 인쇄 or 프린트하다.

examples.ko: 이 문서는 하루에 백 장씩 프린트돼요.
examples.en: This document is printed a hundred copies a day.
The test papers have already been printed.
The ticket will be printed soon.
Please wait a moment while it is printing.
After the photo was printed, I put it in a frame.
The letters are printed small, so they are hard to read.

explain: '프린트하다'는 사람이 인쇄하는 쪽이고 '프린트되다'는 종이에 인쇄되어 나오는 쪽을 봐요. '프린트가 나오다'라고 말하기도 해요.
explain_en: 프린트하다 looks at the person who prints, while 프린트되다 looks at what comes out printed on the paper. People also say 프린트가 나오다.
